title: Units are the complement of the maximal ideal in a local ring
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative local ring [def-weil-pbc-depth], meaning that it has exactly one maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$. For every $x\in R$, one has $x\notin\mathfrak m$ if and only if $x$ is a unit of $R$ (there exists $y\in R$ with $xy=1$).
